steps.en: Notices past the 2nd letter become reminder candidates
steps.id: Notice setelah surat ke-2 jadi calon reminder

steps.en: The driver's newest mobile number is looked up
steps.why_en: The lookup is switched off by configuration, so only the stored number is used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian dimatikan konfigurasi, jadi hanya nomor tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: The new number is saved on the driver's record
steps.id: Nomor baru disimpan di data driver
steps.why_en: Saving only happens after the lookup, which is switched off.
steps.why_id: Penyimpanan hanya terjadi setelah pencarian, yang dimatikan.

steps.en: Drivers without a valid mobile number are skipped
steps.id: Driver tanpa nomor mobile valid dilewati

steps.en: Valid numbers go into the reminder batch for sending
steps.id: Nomor valid masuk batch reminder untuk dikirim
steps.why_en: The reminder job is switched off by configuration, so it does not run by itself.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dimatikan konfigurasi, jadi tidak jalan sendiri.
